ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Validation_Status__c, "Validated"), OR( ISBLANK(Requested_Product__c), ISBLANK(Requested_Quantity__c), Requested_Quantity__c <= 0, ISBLANK(Delivery_City__c), ISBLANK(Requested_Date__c), ISBLANK(Opportunity__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A validated request must contain a product, positive quantity, delivery city, requested date and opportunity.
